eyebrow: The old model vs. the new one
code:
OLD MODEL (castle-and-moat):
IF   connection is inside the firewall
THEN trust it completely, no further checks

ZERO TRUST:
EVERY request -> verify explicitly
(regardless of inside or outside the network)
caption: Zero Trust replaces one perimeter check with a check on every single request.

steps.label: Verify Explicitly
steps.sub: Authenticate and authorize using every available signal, every time

steps.label: Least Privilege Access
steps.sub: Grant only the access needed, for only as long as it's needed

steps.label: Assume Breach
steps.sub: Design and monitor as if an attacker is already inside

steps.label: Remote Work
steps.sub: Users connect from home networks, coffee shops, anywhere

steps.label: Cloud Resources
steps.sub: Apps and data live outside any on-prem network boundary

steps.label: No Single Perimeter
steps.sub: There's no one firewall left to defend

subtitle: Breaking one trusted zone into many small, secured segments.
